parent_objective: design guarded PPO readiness protocol from the Candidate B public-gate base
blocked_by: Candidate B is promoted but PPO continuation has no guarded readiness protocol yet
invalidates: running PPO directly from Candidate B without readiness design

public_gates: M1025 must design PPO readiness only
M1025 must not use private holdout
M1025 must preserve P0 actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in the design milestone
do not promote from smoke PPO

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo: Candidate B guarded PPO readiness design
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts guarded PPO readiness branch from the Candidate B public-gate base
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no PPO run, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if rollback criteria cannot be specified
stop if proof, generalization, and behavior gates are not separated
stop if the protocol would allow promotion from a smoke PPO result
fallback_plan: if readiness design is accepted, run exactly one smoke-scale PPO proposal in the next milestone
if proof risk is too high, route to post-promotion surface refresh before PPO
if generalization risk is too high, route to additional public generalization first
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1024 opens the Candidate B guarded PPO readiness branch

hypothesis: A smoke-scale guarded PPO proposal from Candidate B should only be attempted after explicit exact/proof/generalization/behavior rollback criteria are designed.
success_criteria: base checkpoint and PPO proposal scope are explicit
proof, generalization, behavior, and rollback gates are specified
PPO, promotion, and private holdout remain blocked
failure_criteria: design allows promotion from smoke PPO
decision_rule: M1025 should admit a single smoke-scale guarded PPO proposal only if rollback and gate ordering are explicit.
